pattern: なくはない / なくもない
aliases: naku wa nai / naku mo nai
purpose: Cautiously admit a limited possibility or degree.
keywords: い-adjective stem + くはない / くもない; Vない stem + なくはない / なくもない
I can understand that feeling to some extent.
It is not impossible to walk there, but it is quite far.
This proposal is not bad either.
formation: い-adjective stem + くはない / くもない; Vない stem + なくはない / なくもない
restrictions: Double negation offers qualified rather than enthusiastic agreement.
mistake: Do not interpret it as an unqualified positive.
